work.summary: HISTORICAL FIXTURE (not a statement about current swarm behavior). Three-family /swarm:review --fix on a swarm 0.7.1 branch: 6 of 8 external wrapper agents were blocked, 2 returned findings, yet the workflow reported no backend errors and all families present.

task_id.reason: work-system tasks carry no task ID; the task name is the identity

task_path.reason: worktree task copy not recorded at report time

pr.reason: no PR opened at the time of the review

model.reason: historical reconstruction; authoring model not preserved

usage.completeness_reason: only the review run is described; earlier skill use in the lane is unknown

plugin_version.source: branch under review (the executing install version was not recorded)

outcome.intended: Cross-family review of the branch with verified findings applied by --fix.
outcome.achieved: Review completed with 2 of 8 external voices; presented as a healthy multi-family result.

domain.reason: ordinary review of a small branch

tooling.reason: a partial transport block was indistinguishable from an empty review without reading the journal

worked_well.observation: The 2 external voices that got through returned real findings.

friction.expected: Blocked voices appear as backend errors and reduce family coverage.
friction.observed: backendErrors was empty and every family counted as present although 6 of 8 external voices produced no result.
friction.impact: Cross-family consensus was computed over three quarters missing coverage; a --pr run would have posted it as complete.

resolution.detail: found by reading the journal; tracked as a separate fix task

suspected_cause.text: Resultless resolves are mapped fail-open (ok: r?.ok !== false).

interventions.description: Read the workflow journal to discover the failed agents.
interventions.reason: the report itself showed no failure

items.change: Pair planned voices with results by index and fail closed on a missing result.
items.observation: 6 failed agents left no result record and no rejection.
items.expected_benefit: Partial loss becomes visible in-band, including in --pr output.

handoff.fix: --fix ran on the reduced finding set

runs.benefit_vs_effort: Unclear: the result looked complete, so its benefit was overstated.
